## C · SLA watchdog & morning digest
The promise on the confirmation page is "a formal quotation within 2 business days". This is the node that keeps it true.

Runs Sunday–Thursday at 08:00, 12:00 and 16:00 Asia/Riyadh (set the workflow timezone to Asia/Riyadh). It emails only when something is overdue, plus a digest of the last 24 h on the 08:00 run — no noise, so the alert keeps its meaning.

Set the row status to anything other than New / In review once a quotation is sent, and the reminder stops.
